notes: Tuition not stated: the studyfinder page says "State Scholarships Not available" and the admission page only offers scholarship or fee-paying options without any fee amount ("Students may also choose to participate as fee-paying applicants"), so no tuition sum can be quoted for a self-financed non-EU student. The application channel is inferred from the university's own admission page telling applicants to submit documents and contact the college directly; no Stipendium Hungaricum application sentence for a self-financed applicant exists on these pages (the studyfinder page says State Scholarships are Not available for this programme). One manual_check rule appears to have unsupported evidence (the dinner quote was not found on the page); it should be audited before use.
